projects.title: Website Redesign Request for Proposal
projects.summary: Audit and redesign the website and subdomains, addressing information architecture, accessibility, responsiveness, SEO, and performance, with source handover, documentation, training materials, and six months of debugging support.

requirements.text: Audit the existing website and subdomains.
Develop the redesigned site's information architecture.
Deliver a working redesigned website addressing accessibility, responsiveness, SEO, and performance.
Hand over reusable website templates.
Provide maintenance documentation.
Provide training materials.
Provide six months of debugging support.
Hand over the website source code.

exclusions: No private CMS credentials, source repositories, or unpublished site content may be used.
No site deployment, design approval, customer contact, or support commitment is authorized.
No full briefs, page snapshots, or external website content may be fetched into the paid pilot.

projects.title: Disaster Data-Driven Outreach Project Technology Consultant
projects.summary: Create a GIS dashboard combining FEMA disaster-assistance indicators and Census/ACS demographics for outreach, and implement a technology-enabled staff and volunteer scheduling process with staff training.

requirements.text: Deliver a GIS outreach dashboard combining FEMA assistance indicators and Census/ACS demographics.
Design a technology-enabled process for coordinating staff and volunteer outreach schedules.
Implement the outreach coordination process.
Train staff to use the outreach coordination process.

exclusions: No legal client records, real staff or volunteer schedules, or private operational systems may be used.
No advocacy to obtain FEMA denial data, customer contact, or live workflow implementation is authorized.
No full briefs or external datasets may be fetched into the paid pilot; availability and licenses remain unverified.

projects.title: Plastic demand reduction literature review
projects.summary: Commission three or four regional literature reviews of plastic-demand reduction policies and interventions, covering North America and Europe among the contracts and examining implementation, transferability, strengths, limitations, and quantitative evidence.

requirements.text: Produce regional policy and intervention reviews grounded in peer-reviewed and reputable non-academic literature.
Analyze the strengths and limitations of plastic-demand reduction policies and interventions.
Describe how the reviewed policies and interventions were implemented.
Assess applicability of the reviewed approaches in other regions.
Report quantitative evidence of plastic volumes covered by the reviewed approaches.
Report quantitative evidence of plastic-demand reductions achieved.

exclusions: No private analyses, unlicensed literature, or paywalled material without rights may be used.
No full briefs or external literature corpus may be fetched into the paid pilot.
No fabricated citations, quantitative findings, causal conclusions, or customer submissions are authorized.

projects.title: Measurement & Evaluation Consultant
projects.summary: Conduct mixed-methods evaluation of the Campus Action Planning for Civic & Community Engagement initiative, producing evaluation tools, reports, a future measurement framework, reporting templates, a monitoring dashboard, and evaluation of a Chief Engagement Officer learning community.

requirements.text: Develop a mixed-methods evaluation plan.
Develop data-collection tools.
Produce interim evaluation reports.
Produce outcome evaluation reports.
Develop a future measurement framework.
Provide reporting templates.
Provide a monitoring dashboard.
Evaluate the Chief Engagement Officer learning community.

exclusions: No participant responses, private baselines, consent records, or internal implementation records may be used.
No participant outreach, data collection, invented evaluation results, or operational dashboard deployment is authorized.
No full briefs or client datasets may be supplied to the paid pilot.

projects.title: Strategic Planning Consultant
projects.summary: Assess organizational and program performance, engage constituents, analyze the environment and competition, review financial sustainability, and develop a three-to-five-year strategic plan with implementation resources and a board presentation.

requirements.text: Provide a strategic-planning workplan.
Conduct four to six constituent engagement sessions.
Report organizational, program, environmental, competitive, and financial sustainability assessments.
Deliver draft and final versions of a three-to-five-year strategic plan.
Provide an executive summary of the strategic plan.
Provide a budget framework supporting the strategic plan.
Provide a staffing framework supporting the strategic plan.
Present the strategic plan to the board.

exclusions: No internal organizational documents, financial records, constituent notes, or personal data may be used.
No engagement sessions, customer contact, board presentation, or strategic approval is authorized.
No full briefs or client materials may be supplied to the paid pilot.

projects.title: Request For Proposal (RFP)
projects.summary: Develop a Global Education Security Standard third-party certification assessment framework and perform subsequent product assessments, covering risk/size tiers, applicable certification evidence, remediation, documentation, validity, recertification, and breach handling.

requirements.text: Define risk- and size-based assessment tiers.
Incorporate reuse of applicable certification evidence into the assessment framework.
Conduct product-level certification assessments.
Define remediation windows.
Provide remediation action plans.
Provide assessment documentation.
Define assessment validity and recertification rules.
Define breach-handling provisions.

exclusions: Assessment of A4L itself or schools/districts directly is excluded by the buyer.
No private product evidence, assessment records, or incident details may be used.
Provider-owned assessment data cannot be reused for secondary purposes or training and ordinarily must be destroyed after assessment under section 3.2.
No security testing, system access, certification decisions, customer contact, or actual product assessments are authorized.
No full briefs or private datasets may be supplied to the paid pilot.

template.unit_definition: One listed requirement per Extract, Classify, or Plan unit; one project scoping report per Report unit. These are not full-project execution units.
template.scope: Public-request scoping only. Do not fetch sources, access private inputs, contact customers, deploy anything, or claim delivery.

operations.instruction: Return an array of objects with exactly requirement_id and evidence. Include each listed requirement once in order. evidence must equal its supplied text exactly.

Return an array of objects with exactly requirement_id, brick, owner. Include every requirement in order and preserve the supplied experimental brick and owner annotations exactly; they are not buyer staffing claims.

Return an array with every requirement in order. Each object has exactly requirement_id, owner, prerequisite_status, review_required, and proposed_artifact. Preserve owner. Set prerequisite_status to unverified and review_required to true. proposed_artifact is a concise, specific proposed scoping artifact (20-300 characters), not completed work or invented findings. Discovering delivery dependencies requires additional authorized inputs.

Return an object with exactly source_url, requirement_ids, exclusions, delivery_status, and summary. Preserve the supplied URL, ordered requirement IDs, and all exclusion strings exactly. delivery_status must be not_executed. summary is a concise scoping summary (40-600 characters) that describes the requested work and missing evidence without inventing outcomes or claiming delivery.

pricing_source.boundary: Standard Global synchronous requests, short context. Retail-rate calculated cost, not reconciled invoice, discounts, tax, or procurement budget. Batching here means merging work into one normal request, not the Azure Batch API.

authorization.inputs: Only the six paraphrased public-request summaries, requirement annotations, exclusions, and scoping template.
authorization.tools: None. No source fetch, private data, client contact, deployment, or full-project execution.
authorization.retries: None. Stop after transport, telemetry, output-cap, or identity failure; preserve uncertain reservations.
authorization.quality: Automatic contract checks are necessary but not sufficient. Free-text drafts require human review before quality-preserving optimization can be promoted.
